title: Resonance
summary: RES'ONANCE, noun s as z. [Latin resonans.] 1. A resounding; a sound returned from the sides of a hollow instrument of music; reverberated sound or sounds. 2. A sound returned.

inlines.v: RES'ONANCE, noun s as z. [Latin resonans.] 1. A resounding; a sound returned from the sides of a hollow instrument of music; reverberated sound or sounds. 2. A sound returned.
